room_rent.note: Room rent is 'Any Room' as per Schedule of Benefits. Optional Room Rent Modification rider allows downgrade to Single Private A/C, Shared, or General Ward for premium discount.

icu.note: ICU charges covered as part of inpatient treatment up to sum insured; no separate sub-limit stated.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment on base covers. Voluntary co-payment (10%/20%/30%/40%/50%) available as optional cover for premium discount. OPD benefit has 20% co-pay on reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.display: Few sub-limits: Home Care 10% SI, Bariatric ₹3-7L, Newborn 10% SI, Nano 25% SI
sub_limits.note: Most covers up to SI. Sub-limits apply to: Home Care Treatment (10% SI or ₹5L), Bariatric Surgery (₹3L for SI 5-15L; ₹6L for 20-100L; ₹7L for 200L), Newborn Baby (10% SI or ₹2.5L/₹5L), Nanotechnology (25% SI). Optional Sub-limits cover available for specific diseases.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Voluntary Aggregate Deductible available as optional cover for premium discount.

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 24 or 12 mo via optional add-on)
ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional cover allows reduction to 24 or 12 months on payment of additional premium at inception only.

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (reducible to 12 mo via optional add-on)
specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions (cataract, ENT, hernia, joint replacement, etc.). Optional cover reduces to 12 months.

maternity.display: Optional add-on (2yr wait for couple; 4yr for single woman)
maternity.note: Delivery Expenses optional cover: Normal up to ₹25K (SI 5L), ₹50K (SI 7.5-15L), ₹1L (SI 20L+); Caesarean double those limits. Waiting: both self & spouse covered 2 yrs continuously, or insured woman alone 4 yrs. Max 2 deliveries lifetime.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% of SI per year
cumulative_bonus.note: 100% of SI bonus if no claim in previous year; 25% of SI if claim made. Not cumulative — applies each year independently. Enhanced Multiplier 3X or 10X optional cover provides additional cumulative bonus up to 3x or 10x SI.

restoration.note: Automatic restoration of 100% SI each time for unlimited number of times, for same or different illness including accidents. Triggers on partial or full utilization.

day_care.display: All day-care procedures covered up to SI

domiciliary.note: Covered for illness requiring >3 days treatment at home. Excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, psychiatric disorders, etc.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to SI. Yoga & Naturopathy require prior approval.

organ_donor.note: Donor: redo surgery/ICU complications covered (in addition to SI). Insured as donor: covered up to SI. 24-month waiting period. Stem cell donation excluded except bone marrow.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to sum insured for transport to hospital, between hospitals, and hospital to residence (same city). Air ambulance optional cover up to 10% of SI.

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, intravitreal injections (max 3/eye/period), deep brain stimulation, balloon sinuplasty, bronchial thermoplasty, stereotactic radio surgeries, oral chemotherapy, etc.

consumables.display: Optional add-on (68 items + admission/record/insurance processing charges)
consumables.note: Consumables cover is an optional add-on for Neo Plan. Covered up to SI when admissible inpatient/day care claim exists.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit is India only. Accidental Death & PTD optional cover applies worldwide.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim contestable except for proven fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly/2/4/12 instalment modes; 15 days for monthly mode.

notable_exclusions: Permanent exclusions for disclosed diseases (Excl 38); venereal diseases; dental unless accident; refractive error <7.5D; EECP/chelation/hyperbaric O2; erectile dysfunction; hazardous sports
optional_riders: Insta Care (PED from day 31 for ABCD), Enhanced Multiplier 3X/10X, Delivery Expenses, ART, Consumables, High-End Diagnostics, Air Ambulance, OPD Benefit (Silver/Gold/Platinum/Diamond), Accidental Death & PTD, Preferred Partner Network, Voluntary Deductible/Co-pay, Sub-limits, Advance Access
